Overview Approval Disapproval Banter Location Remarks Romance Cinematics

Karlach detests improbity and malignity, as well as unkind and dastardly acts, or leaving others in peril.

Karlach disapproves of unnecessary cruelty and deception, as well as acts of cowardice, ignobility and treachery. She dislikes deliberate refusing to help those in need (especially children and her own kin), and does not approve of cruel or evil comments or jokes.

Due to her tribulations in Avernus, Karlach detests and holds little to no regard (or trust) for most devils.

The story and dialogue choices listed on this page lower  Karlach's approval.

All entries for disapproval values shown on this page come directly from official in-game dialogue files as of Patch 7. However, in any given playthrough, specific changes in disapproval may not trigger for several reasons, primarily among them: installed mods or a game bug.[note 1]

For more information about the approval system, see Approval.

Act One

Locations

Roadside Cliffs

  • Speaking with the tieflings holding Lae'zel in a cage, choose to attack them (-1)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, tear off Gale's hand (-1)
  • Near the Chapel Entrance, convince Gimblebock and his crew to flee (using any check-based or class-based option) (-1)

The Emerald Grove

In The Hollow:

  • Take a swing at Zevlor during his argument with Aradin (-1)
  • Refuse to help Zevlor persuade Kagha to let the tieflings stay (-1)
  • Scold Elegis for being scared of a few goblins OR tell her to get to digging their own graves (-1) (either option)
  • Dig out the recently made grave near the gate (-1)

Note: The grave appears at X: 174 Y: 445 upon long rest after initial scene when approaching the grove. It might be made to bury Kanon, Aradin or Zevlor

  • Tell Arron that the refugees will be fine due to their devilish powers (-1)
  • Tell the tiefling kids trained by Asharak that they are going to die (-1)
  • Talk to Strange Ox (without  Speak with Animals) and call it a hideous cow (-1)
  • Kick Timber the squirrel (-1).
    • If you miss, try to kick her again (-1)
    • Playing as  The Dark Urge, when you are confronted by a companion about kicking Timber, answer that it came right at you OR that your instincts are sharp (-1)
  • Make Zorru kneel before Lae'zel (-1)
    • Stop Lae'zel, then let her continue the interrogation (-1)
    • After Lae'zel has questioned Zorru, praise her interrogation technique (-1)
  • Offer to heal Pandirna for a price, but pocket the money and leave (-1)
    • OR Tell Pandirna to hush or you will snap her neck (-1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian)
  • Let Arka shoot Sazza (-1)
  • Free Sazza from her cage and tell her to follow you (-1)
  • During Meli and Barth's confrontation about the stolen locket
    • Choose not to get involved (-1)
    • Let Barth hit Meli for stealing his locket (-1)
    • Tell Meli to return the trinket, because "There's already one thief to bury today." (-1)

Note: This line is available only if Arabella has died

  • Make Barth pay you for his locket, if you get it back from Meli (-1)
  • While talking to/trading with Mattis, either pocket his "lucky ring" straightaway OR Tell him you've earned it (-1)
    • Then, catch Silfy trying to pickpocket you and grab her by the hand (-1)
  • Playing as a  Lolth-Sworn Drow, talking to Mol after having messed with one of her friends, threaten to tear her spine out (-1)
    • If confronting Mol about your stolen belongings,  threaten to rip her tail off (-1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian)
  • At the Tiefling Hideout, tell Mirkon you've heard enough of his chatter (-1)
  • After successfully stealing the Idol of Silvanus for Mol, tell her that you will keep it for yourself (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Rogue, advise her not to ask, just take (-1)
  • Refuse Zevlor to kill the goblin horde's leaders (-1)

In the Sacred Pool and druid caves:

  • After resolving Arabella's fate, tell Kagha that you you just wanted to see what would happen (-5)
    • OR Praise Kagha for protecting her own (-5)
    • OR Tell her that it was quite a show (-5)
    • If Arabella died, speak to Rath and blame the child (-1)
  • Tell Locke and Komira that they should have tried parenting Arabella (-1)
    • If Arabella has died, lie to Locke and Komira that Kagha will release her soon (-1)
  • Prod Nettie's bird twice (-1)
  • Swear to Nettie that you will take the wyvern poison if you start turning (-1)

Note: Works either Nettie has or hasn't already scratched any party member with a deadly briar

  • As a  Rogue, pick Mirkon's pockets while he is distracted by the harpies (-1)
    • After saving Mirkon from the harpies, tell him to stop snivelling or the harpies will return (-1)
  • Playing as a  Bard, talk to the squirrels listening to Alfira and first hush them not to ruin the song, then choose to sing along with them (-1)
    • Steal Alfira's extra lute (-1)
    • Take Alfira's lute out of her hands and smash it (-1)
    • Tell Alfira she should give up on her song (-1)

While the Emerald Grove is preparing for the goblin attack

  • Tell Mirkon you are not going to save him again OR that he's on his own (-1) (either option depending on whether you saved Mirkon from the harpies or not)
  • Tell Pandirna that you are here for the show (-1)
  • Tell Zevlor (or Asharak if Zevlor is dead) that it was you who led the horde to the grove, then add that this place belongs to the Absolute (-10)
    • OR That the horde is coming, led by the drow - and you are with them (-10)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, tell Zevlor that the goblin horde is yours (-1)
  • Betray the Grove (open the gate) after blowing the horn (-10)

Sunlit Wetlands/Putrid Bog

  • If Astarion is not in the party, tell Gandrel how to find your camp (-1)
  • If Astarion is in the party, reveal his identity to Gandrel (-1)
    • OR Don't rat Astarion out and allow him to kill the hunter further in the dialogue (-1)

Note: The latter option is available only if you already know that Astarion is a vampire

In Overgrown Tunnel:

  • When Auntie Ethel surrenders, let her go and keep Mayrina in exchange for the fey hair (-1)
  • If you killed Auntie Ethel:
    • If you spared Mask of Regret, speak to her afterwards and choose to attack her (-1)
    • Playing as a  Duergar, take the Petrification off Efrin and laugh at him (-1)
      • When Efrin asks to examine him, refuse to do it (-1)

Forest, Owlbear Nest and Blighted Village

  • In the Underground Passage, heal Findal, then tell him you are here to finish the job, and kill him (-1)
  • Talking to Scratch via  Speak with Animals, shout at the Gomwick's corpse to prove he indeed is dead (-1)
  • While talking to Aradin on the bridge, say you don't waste your time with devilspawn (-5)

Note: This scene appears only if Aradin has previously left the grove

  • Choose to come closer to the Owlbear Cub OR Attack the Mother Owlbear (-1)
  • After killing the Mother Owlbear, kill the cub as well (-1)

In Blighted Village:

  • Read the Necromancy of Thay (-1)
  • Interrupt the bugbear and ogre couple in the barn (-1)
    • OR let Astarion interrupt them (if he is in party) (-1)

Note: The latter option is available only if neither Shadowheart nor Wyll are in the party, otherwise one of them would interfere and try to stop the player

  • Pay Fezzerk a lot of gold to let you pass (-1)
    • OR Attack the gang, and when Fezzerk begs for mercy, deliver the final blow (-1)

Goblin Camp

In the outer camp:

  • Yell "Boo, get off the stage!" at Volo as he performs (-1)
  • Tell Tracker Grikka that you will get answers from prisoners (-1)
    • Playing as a  Dwarf, ask Grikka to save a piece of dwarf meat for you (-1)
  • Using  Speak with Animals, tell the Dishevelled Chicken to shut up and play (-1)
    • OR Instruct the chicken to run to the finish posts (-1)

Note: These options are available if you have killed the Owlbear Cub in its nest

  • Playing a tour of chicken-chasing, tell the Owlbear Cub to run to the posts, using  Speak with Animals (-1)
  • Kiss Crusher's foot (-1)
    • If Crusher attacks you and begs for mercy, finish him (-1) (triggers a fight with the entire camp)

In the Shattered Sanctum:

  • Promise Minthara to get information from the captive (-1)
  • Tell Torturer Spike to let you put the prisoner through paces (-1)
    • OR Use unique lines for a  Drow or  The Dark Urge (-1) (either option)
    • Then torture Liam yourself (-1)
    • After questioning Liam, leave him chained to the rack (-1)
  • Tell Minthara that Sazza was too stupid to understand you prior (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Lolth-Sworn Drow, tell Sazza she should have see a superior in you at once (-1)

Note: Sazza must be freed from the cage in Emerald Grove

  • Agree to attack the Grove with Minthara with or without asking for a reward (-5) (if you confirm you intent, Karlach might leave the party)

In the Worg Pens:

  • Tell goblin children to keep at the bear, to aim for his eye, or to use sharper stones (-1) (either option)
    • Throw a rock yourself (-1) (Makes Halsin hostile)
    • OR Make Brawler Birka release the bear and then attack the animal (-1)
  • Refuse Halsin to help him save the grove after freeing him (-1)

Underdark and Grymforge

  • Agree to hunt down Thulla for Gekh Coal, for reward or for free (-1)
  • Steal Boots of Speed from Thulla (-1)
  • Tell Derryth Bonecloak you're going to keep the Noblestalk for yourself (-1)
    • OR  Intimidate her into giving you a reward, then take it and keep the mushroom (-1)
    • If Baelen Bonecloak ate the Noblestalk himself, tell Derryth you know exactly what you've done (-1)
  • Agree to be BOOOAL's Chosen (-1)

In Grymforge:

  • When Lunkbug tells you where to find Philomeen, answer that you'll take her head for a trophy (-1)
    • After finding Philomeen, talk to Lunkbug and say she's done for (-1)
  • Ask Ward Magmar how to get a slave of your own (-1)
  •  Persuade the Deep Rothé to excavate for Skarjall (-1)
  • Provoke a fight against Elder Brithvar by either taunting him to try and take your gold OR suggesting to rat him out to Sergeant Thrinn about his conspiracy against Nere (-1) (either option)
  • After freeing Nere, side with him OR with Brithvar (-5) (either option)
  • If you killed the duergar (both rebels and Absolutists) before freeing Nere, kill the gnome slaves as well on the drow's orders (-5)
    • OR Attack Nere instead of gnomes (-1)
  • Let the duergar take the enslaved gnomes after defeating Nere (-5)

The Risen Road, Waukeen's Rest and Zhentarim Hideout

  • Order Flind to attack the other gnolls instead of you (-1)
  • Save Rugan, then  convince him to surrender the cargo OR provoke a fight with him (-1) (either option)
  • If you fail the  Intimidation check, say you can harm him no less worse than gnolls would have (-1) (makes Rugan hostile)
  • At the tollhouse, tell the merchant Cyrel that you'll take the supplies and everything else she owns (-1)

Note: In order to talk to Cyrel peacefully, Karlach must be in  disguise, otherwise the trader will turn hostile immediately

  • Leave Benryn to die under the wreckage (-1)
    • If you saved Benryn, tell him you'll keep the dowry as a payment for his saving (-1)
  • Kill Rugan, if he survived Zarys's torture and your fight against other Zhentarim (-1)
  • Purchase Oskar Fevras from Brem, then speak to the artist and call him a slave twice (-5)
    • OR, Having spoken to Oskar AND Brem, return to the artist and say you've got enough problems (-1)

Mountain Pass and Crèche Y'llek

  • Attack Ellyka near the point of encounter with githyanki patrol (-1)
    • OR, Being  disguised as a gith, provoke her to attack you (-1)
  • Speak with Voss yourself instead of letting Lae'zel do it (-1) (using any line of two available)

In the Crèche Y'llek:

  • Upon entering the crèche, playing as a  Ranger,  intimidate Gish Far'aag to let you in, using class-based line (-1)
  • Offer to fight Youth Varrl when Sa'varsh Kethk asks for a challenger (-1), and then indeed kill him (-1)
  • Tell Varsh Ko'kuu that if he gives you the Githyanki Egg you'll sell it at best price OR make yourself an omelette (-1) (either option)
    • OR Crush the Githyanki Egg (-1) (Not available for a  Githyanki character)

Note: Any threat of doing harm to the egg or its destruction makes Ko'kuu and hatchery guards hostile

  • Surrender the Mysterious Artefact to Kith'rak Therezzyn (-1)
  • Tell Vlaakith you're a friend who brought the artefact to her (-1)
    • OR Rat Shadowheart out that it was she who stole it (-1) (the line is available only if Shadowheart is in the party)
  • Agree to Vlaakith's demands to kill the person inside the Mysterious Artefact (-1)

Campsite and Conversations[note 2]

Raphael's Deal

  • When Raphael briefly takes you to the House of Hope, say that you'll do anything to get rid of the tadpole (-1)
  • Discussing the devil's offer afterwards:
    • Say you should at least hear the him out/consider his offer (-1)
    • OR Say that no cost is too great, if it rids you of infection (-1)
    • OR First say you do not trust him, then change your mind (-5)
    • Then say again he could be a friend you all need (-5) (can be added to previous disapproval)

Camp interactions:

  • If Arabella died, and Kagha survived, Komira will try to poison and kill the druid at the celebration.  Talk her out of it (-1)

Other companions and camp followers

  • Playing as Astarion origin, when your nature comes out, tell Karlach not to patronise you (-10)
    • Then say you revel in your mysteries (-5)
  • If Karlach is recruited before Wyll, he will show up in camp after a long rest. Tell him it's all over OR that the Blade of Frontiers will be a memory come tomorrow (-1) (either option)
  • Flirt with Mizora when she shows up (-1)
    • Ask Mizora whether she leaves if you turn on Karlach (-5)
  • Playing as Wyll origin, tell Mizora you shouldn't have disobeyed OR Ask what if you kill Karlach now (-5) (either option)
  • After Mizora warps Wyll into a devil, talk to Karlach and say it was a foolish decision (-10)

Note: This option brings approval for all characters except  Warlock

  • Playing as a  Cleric of  Selune, when Shadowheart reveals herself as a Sharran near Selûne statues in Goblin Camp, call  Shar an abomination (-1)
  • Let Volo follow through his attempt to remove the parasite (-1)
  • Shoo the Owlbear Cub out of the camp (-1) (works both at first and second appearing)
    • Choose to attack the cub (-1) (with or without  Speak with Animals)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, confess to murdering the bard (-1)
    • OR Fail the roll to  deceive the others by any story (-1)

Companion quest

  • Speaking to Anders and his crew with Karlach in the party, choose to "leave them in peace", then tell Karlach to stand down (-5)
  • Tell Karlach you doubt about using Soul Coins OR Don't allow her to use a coin (-5) (either option)

Act Two

Locations

Ruined Battlefield

If entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Grymforge:

  • When the Shadows warp Harper Yonas, choose to run from the fight (-1)

If entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Rosymorn Monastery Trail:

  • Traversing Shadow-Cursed Lands with the convoy and Kar'niss the drider, protect them from Harpers, thus maintaining your cover as a True Soul (-1)
    • OR Side with the ambushing Harpers. After defeating the convoy, tell the Harpers' leader you're going to kill them and keep the Moonlantern (-1)

Note:Immediately starts the fight with remaining Harpers. Works, too, if you managed to pick up the Moonlantern during the battle

  • If ambushing the convoy with the Harpers, start the dialogue with the drider and reveal the ambush to it (-1)

Dealing with He Who Was:

  • Order Madeline to hurt herself as Ben and Marc did (-1) (Evil  Cleric characters have unique line here)
    • Then tell her to stab herself and don't stop OR to prove she is sorry (-1) (either option)
    • Finally succeed a  Persuasion roll to keep her going (-1)

Elsewhere:

  • Talking to Dolly Thrice, ignore her pleads two times and keep the Moonlantern (-1)

Last Light Inn

  • Speaking to Jaheira inside the inn, say you drink to darkness that will come when you drag Isobel to Moonrise Towers (-10) (Available if you have Disciple Z'rell's orders to do it)

Dealing with Isobel and Marcus:

  • If Marcus vouched for you at the entrance (in this case he will wait in Isobel's room):
    • Agree to help him kidnap Isobel OR Say that you are going to take the cleric yourself (-1) (either option)
    • OR Speak to Isobel and say that she is coming with you (-10)
  • If Marcus assaults the inn (happens if you gained entrance with Mol's help):
    • After speaking to Marcus telepathically, tell Isobel that she is going to meet Ketheric face to face (-10)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, obey your Urge and tell Isobel you crave to kill her (-10) (this option is available either before kidnapping attempt, or after assault, or if you return to the inn after freeing Nightsong; turns hostile Isobel and any Harper who sees it)

Talking to His Majesty via  Speak with Animals:

  • Hiss back at him, say that he is in your territory, and order to get out (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Barbarian, WOOF at him (-1)

Speaking to Cerys:

  • When she tell you about their misfortunes, coinclude that she abandoned others (-1) (use basic line or unique for  Barbarian,  Fighter,  Monk or  Paladin (except  Oathbreaker))
  • Ask her what they are doing here, then say she did the right mess of things (-1)

Talking to Alfira:

  • After Marcus's assault, when she asks whether they cannot trust anyone, tell her to stop whining (-1)
  • Ask her about others, then say that it was a cowardly move (-1)
  • When Alfira asks you how do you keep going, answer that you don't complain constantly (-1)
  • When Alfira supposes that surviving tieflings were taken to the Moonrise Towers, say you imagine the cultists are torturing them right now (-1)

Speaking with Bex and Danis:

  • Before trying to saving captured refugees:
  • Tell Bex that Danis is now goblin chow toy OR that they've probably killed and eaten him (-1) (either option)
  • If Danis died while saving attempt, tell Bex that he is better off dead than abandoned in Moonrise (-1)

Dealing with Rolan, Cal and Lia:

  • Speaking to drunken Rolan before trying to save captured refugees:
    • Tell him that his siblings are better off dead than in cult's hands OR Tell him to stop whining (-1) (either option)
  • If either Cal or Lia (or both) died while rescue attempt, garble their names and say you don't know them (-1)
  • If both siblings survived, after they thank you, ask who is going to pay you (-1)
  • If Rolan died in battle with Shadows, tell either Cal or Lia that he died as he lived - stupidly (-1)

Talking to Ide after drunken Rolan has snapped on her:

  • Call Rolan a grump, and when Ide complains he called her a "ragged little devil", say that he was observant (-1)
  • When Ide shows you the book she means to keep for Rolan, convince her to give it to you, using  Deception or  Intimidation (-1)

Talking to Harper Meygan mourning Yonas:

  • Say that Yonas was better at joking than at keeping himself alive (-1)
    • OR Say that he'd still be around if spent less time on joking (-1)
  • If you looted Yonas's body, offer Meygan to take Yonas's sword, then say you were kidding and keep it (-1)

Elsewhere in the inn:

  • After Mol is taken during the assault, tell Mattis she's probably dead already (-1)
  • Tell Counsellor Florrick you have no intentions to go to Moonrise Towers (-1)
  • Question Karlach, when she encourages Mattis about "scamming with the greats" (-5)
    • OR Say that she's too nice to this little runt (-5)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, give in to your urge to kill the Strange Ox (-1)
    • If trying to talk with it without  Speak with Animals, choose to "sneer at the disgusting beast" (-1)

Reithwin Town

At the Reithwin Tollhouse, agree to give up all your gold to Gerringothe Thorm (-1)

At the cemetery:

  • Refuse to help Arabella find her parents (-1)
    • If you agreed, refuse to take Arabella in at your camp (-1)
  • OR, If you've already found Locke and Komira's bodies, tell Arabella they are dead and fail  Persuasion or  Intimidation roll to take her to your camp (-1)

Note:  The Dark Urge characters have unique lines and  Persuasion option only

Moonrise Towers

Witnessing Ketheric's trial (at the very first visit to Moonrise):

  • If Minthara is judged:
    • Playing as  The Dark Urge, after Ketheric declares the sentence, intervene and say you can make Minthara's passing much more creative (-1)
    • Then tell Disciple Z'rell to make her suffer until pain is all she knows (-1)
  • When Z'rell orders you to decide the goblins' fate, kill them through illithid powers (-1)

Note: A  The Dark Urge character have several options, all gaining points

At the Moonrise Towers Prison:

  • When approaching Minthara being tortured:
    • Say you expected to see her dismembered (-1)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, if you failed a  Wisdom check to reach out to Minthara's mind, tell Jasin and Sumera to carve her mind apart (-1)
  • Defeat the questioners, escort Minthara out of Moonrise Towers, then tell her you have saved her only for the pleasure of killing her yourself (-1)
  • Refuse Lakrissa to help them escape, when she accuses you of serving the cult (-1) (requires a  Persuasion or an  Intimidation roll)
  • Tell Wulbren that they can die in prison for all you care (-1)
    • Refuse to find tools for Wulbren (-1)

Elsewhere in Moonrise Towers:

  • While entering the Moonrise for the first time, tell Zealot Malik that you have infiltrated Harpers' encampment (-1)
  • Talking to Z'rell, if you have already helped Balthazar to retrieve Nightsong, agree to kidnap Isobel next (-1)
  • Convince Astarion to bite Araj Oblodra by any means OR Order him directly to do it (-1)
  • Reinforce the connection between Linsella and Barnabus (-1)
  • At the Moonrise Towers docks, use illithid  Wisdom Check on Acolyte Marls, and then tell him to wash the worms off (-1)
  • Refuse to take Soul Coins from Lann Tarv in exchange for stories of the souls trapped inside them (-5)
    • OR Say you want to trade, not to talk (-5)

Note: These options appear in the dialogue with the trader only if Karlach is in the party

Final fight at the Moonrise:

  • In front of Moonrise Towers, reject Jaheira's offer to join you in the upcoming fight (-5)
  • If you haven't come to Last Light Inn at all, before final fight for Moonrise Towers tell Jaheira you are a foe (-5)

Gauntlet of Shar

Dealing with Yurgir and his retinue:

  • If you agreed to help Yurgir, suggest to search the temple for him (-1)
  • Speak to Nessa via  Speak with Animals and  convince her that the orthon sold her to the party (-1)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, tell Nessa you didn't think the displacer beasts were slaves. Then discuss her love to the orthon and finally say that love is a disease like any other (-1)

Near Pedestal of Reckoning and through Shar's trials:

  • When Shadowheart speaks of her need to go through the trials, agree to help her if you can (-1)

Dealing with Balthazar in his outpost, agree to clear the way for him (-1)

In the Shadowfell:

  • Near the Verge of Shadows, agree to search the Spear of Night for Shadowheart (if you don't have it yet) (-1)
  • If you have defeated Balthazar, kill Aylin, too (-1) (works also if playing as Shadowheart origin)
    • OR Allow Shadowheart to kill the aasimar (-1)
  • If Balthazar is present and not hostile to the party, let him take Aylin to Ketheric (-5)

Mind Flayer Colony

In the Necrotic Laboratory:

  • Talking to the Waking Mind via the Slack-Skinned Head:
    • Playing as a  Githyanki, say that this form fits them much better (-1)
    • Succeed the passive  Insight check and choose to consume their mind (-1)
  • Tell the Fresh Mind they will never wake again (-1)

In the Tadpoling Centre:

  • Choose to purge the pods instead of freeing captives (-5)
  • Kill Mizora in her pod (-1)

Note: Choosing this option will cause Wyll to die, too, regardless whether he is in the party or not

  • After that, tell Karlach you don't have time to mourn the dead (-5)

After the final fight with Apostle of Myrkul

Speaking to Cerys:

  • Say they are better off without Zevlor (-1)
    • OR Say "Good riddance" (i.e. to Zevlor) (-1)
  • Tell her people get paid for doing jobs (-1) ( Rogue characters have unique line here)

Talking to Ide, Umi and Mattis:

  • Tell any of them about Mol's eyepatch you have found down in the colony, and then:
    • Tell Ide or Umi that her friend is dead anyway (-1) (either of them)
    • OR Tell Mattis that death happens, and that's it (-1)

Talking to others:

  • Playing as a  Bard, decline Alfira's proposal to play together for the tiefling kids (-1)
  • If you let Balthazar take Aylin from Shadowfell AND Isobel died, tell the aasimar you would betray her again on a whim (-1)
  • Refuse to recruit Jaheira (-2)
  • When Minthara[note 2] tells you she is going to kill Orin, mention the cult might need a new leadership afterwards (-1)

Campsite and Conversations

  • Playing as Evil  Cleric, tell Arabella that being an orphan makes her much more interesting (-1) (Works after you have found her parents dead)
    • Then say she can quit snivelling (-1)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, when confronted about killing your companion instead of Isobel, pick any answer line except choosing to attack straightaway and using  Deception (-10) (either option)

Note: Choosing any of these options turns the companion who found you over the corpse hostile. The only chance to avoid a fight is to succeed  DC 30 Deception Check


Romance

  • Sleep with Karlach, in the morning tell her that it was a mistake, then confirm it (-100)
  • If you were partnered with Karlach and chose to partner with another companion, tell her she was too intense for you (-10)
    • OR Say you have your fun with her (-30)

Companion quest

  • After Dammon upgrades her heart the second time, remind Karlach about returning to Avernus (-5) (works only if you are already romancing her)

Act Three

Locations

Rivington

Talking to Yenna, be rude to the girl:
